Chamber thermistor replacement reference display

Native grid, fan housings, covers and retained screws use the existing Prusa assembly geometry and its notices. Their source surfaces are not replaced by this adapter.

The TEMP lead/plug and socket, two-piece nylon rivets and rear bundle tie use one chamber resource owner. The native fans and their reference anatomy retain their own resource owner. Independently authored connector geometry retains its existing CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and preferred sources. The two-circuit right-angle family extension has inferred internal details, not supplier surfaces or manufacturer metrology.

The sensor has a15.3mm reference probe, a1mm-radius outer jacket and two0.32mm-radius end wires. Its complete analytic route uses a260mm reference length, based on the nominal replacement-part designation rather than a measured neutral strand/cut datum. The hand-held route and probe dimensions are inferred for assembly teaching. The rigid probe and complete cross-section move through the existing grid openings; force, compression and electrical sensing are not simulated.

The old/new grid ties reuse the complete existing procedural tie section and reference stock. The old tie is split at one strip station with retained faces and added cut caps, then opened and moved away. This is an explanatory cut/handling motion, not a fracture simulation. No supplier mesh is copied for the two new tie references. New tie/cut-reference geometry: CC BY-SA 4.0. Full terms: ../../licenses/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt

Preferred editable source: ../../chamber-service-owner.js, ../../chamber-service-plan.js, ../../chamber-service-rivets.js, ../../chamber-service-accessories.js, ../../chamber-service-datums.js, ../../chamber-temp-route.js, ../../chamber-temp-turn.js, ../../chamber-temp-handling.js, ../../chamber-temp-part.js and ../../chamber-thermistor-model.js and ../../chamber-thermistor-view.js. Data/source recipe: ../../../source/chamber-thermistor-replacement/. Authored2-circuit header recipe and scalar parameters: ../../../source/chamber-service-reference/.
